sources.title: The tadpole problem

evidence.text: Differential evolution rounds 484-dimensional real candidate vectors to integer flux matrices. Weighted penalties target eigenvalue, diagonalization, degeneracy, root and tadpole conditions; a subsequent local search changes matrix entries.

sources.title: Algorithmically Solving the Tadpole Problem

evidence.text: Use adaptive DE/rand/1/bin with radius-limited sampling from BlackBoxOptim.jl. Populations evolve real matrices, rounded to integers before evaluation. A weighted fitness combines spectral, diagonalizability, eigenspace-signature and root penalties with the tadpole objective.

sources.title: Moduli stabilization in asymptotic flux compactifications

evidence.text: Construct C_sl(2)=exp(x·N−) e(y)^−1 C∞ e(y) exp(−x·N−), with e(y)=exp[½Σ log(y^k)N_k^0]. Flux-axion polynomials and weight decompositions simplify self-duality equations; their solutions seed numerical refinement with the nilpotent-orbit Hodge star.

sources.title: The desert and the swampland

evidence.text: Compute calibrated cycle volumes from intersection data, then normalize in lower-dimensional Planck units. The six-dimensional period basis and five-dimensional Kähler expansion basis must be distinguished before comparing formulas.

sources.title: The tadpole conjecture in asymptotic limits

evidence.text: For quantization evidence, compute three-fold data with CYTools and mirror symmetry, select partial Kähler-cone generators and saxion orderings, then use Cholesky decomposition to express boundary norms as positive rational coefficients multiplying squares of integer flux combinations.

sources.title: Tadpole conjecture in non-geometric backgrounds

evidence.text: Express G3 either in integral-cycle variables or as Σ_l A_l χ_l in the complex (2,1) basis. Impose integral periods and use the Riemann bilinear identity to express N_flux as a positive weighted quadratic form in |A_l|² at τ = i. Period derivatives supply the superpotential Hessian.

evidence.text: Does the apparent IIB2 counterexample to the Tadpole Conjecture survive when its polynomially corrected stabilization conditions are combined with statistical estimates for large complex-structure moduli spaces?

evidence.text: For a concrete type IIB model with 50 complex-structure moduli, how small can the flux-induced D3 charge be while stabilizing the axio-dilaton and all complex-structure moduli, subject to lower bounds on large-complex-structure and weak-coupling control?

evidence.text: First neglect instanton corrections to the LCS prepotential and construct integer fluxes giving vanishing perturbative F-terms and Wpert along an analytic flat valley. Then restore instanton corrections and solve for stabilization near that valley.

sources.title: Supersymmetric Protection and the Swampland

evidence.text: Test the candidate wrapping cycle for the stated H-flux anomaly and remove the forbidden configuration. This is a cycle-specific selection rule associated with a gauged isometry, rather than a zero-mode-lifting calculation.

sources.title: Conifold Vacua with Small Flux Superpotential

evidence.text: Analytically continue the large-complex-structure prepotential toward a shrinking-curve conifold. Resum the unsuppressed worldsheet multiple-cover contributions using polylogarithm reflection identities, while retaining a controlled expansion in the conifold modulus and instantons on the remaining large curves.

sources.title: Small Flux Superpotentials for Type IIB Flux Vacua Close to a Conifold

evidence.text: Use three stabilization steps: solve the polynomial Uα sector at Z=0 with vanishing superpotential; stabilize Z exponentially in S; then balance instanton and conifold contributions in an effective racetrack superpotential for S. Approximate minima provide starting points for numerical searches in the full eight-real-field potential.

sources.title: Modeling General Asymptotic Calabi–Yau Periods

evidence.text: Restore all permitted lower-weight pieces of each split lowering operator and solve their compatibility constraints. The operation is imported and applied to period reconstruction.

sources.title: Vacua with Small Flux Superpotential

evidence.text: Along U=τp, the effective superpotential is an instanton sum with exponents 2πiτ p·q. A racetrack between the leading terms can stabilize τ at weak coupling when their exponents are sufficiently close; the exponents need not be integers.

sources.title: Flux compactifications on Calabi-Yau threefolds

evidence.text: Can quantized three-form fluxes on Calabi–Yau orientifolds with full SU(3) holonomy yield explicit supersymmetric vacua and nonsupersymmetric no-scale vacua with relatively small W using only a few fluxes?

sources.title: Exact flux vacua, symmetries, and the structure of the landscape

evidence.text: How do symmetries, algebraic reductions of generically transcendental periods, and the distribution of exact W = ∂I W = 0 flux vacua constrain one another, particularly without a tadpole bound?

evidence.text: Do effective-field-theory consistency, phenomenology or vacuum statistics require a hierarchically small type IIB flux superpotential, or can generic W0 of order 1–10 remain consistent after moduli stabilization?
